query:
INSERT INTO tv_series (
            uuid,
            interpretation_id,
            name,
            original_name,
            tmdb_id,
            imdb_id,
            tvdb_id,

            original_language,
            tagline,
            overview,
            first_air_year,
            first_air_month,
            first_air_day,
            tmdb_poster_path,
            sort_name
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        RETURNING id AS "id!: TvSeriesRowId"
